claims.text: Selective oxidation of aluminum rapidly forms a continuous, protective Al2O3 scale.
Lattice distortion in multiprincipal-element alloys suppresses aluminum diffusion from the bulk.
Suppression of aluminum diffusion retards sustained oxide-scale growth.
Diffusion suppression prevents oxide-scale spallation.
A refined lamellar or eutectic microstructure promotes rapid formation of a uniform protective scale.
Lattice distortion elevates vacancy formation energies.
Lattice distortion elevates aluminum migration barriers in the aluminum-depletion zone.
A continuous alumina scale forms at lower critical aluminum concentrations in these alloys.
Increasing or optimizing aluminum content promotes preferential alumina formation.
Y and Hf co-doping can contribute to exceptional oxidation resistance in a NiCoCrAl-type multiprincipal-element alloy at 1200°C.
Optimized aluminum content and favorable microstructure will produce an exclusive Al2O3 scale.
The optimized alloy will have a significantly lower thermally grown oxide growth rate than the baseline.
The optimized alloy will exhibit improved oxide-scale adhesion or negligible spallation relative to the baseline.
Formation of a dense, continuous, and adherent protective scale suppresses oxygen and metal-cation transport.
Protective-scale formation and reduced scale growth improve high-temperature material integrity.
Lower or unoptimized aluminum levels cause formation of mixed oxide scales.
The proposed baseline has faster oxide growth and greater potential for spallation than the optimized alloy.
The proposed mechanism should govern behavior primarily from approximately 1100°C to 1200°C when the alloy microstructure remains stable.
Phase instability, extreme strain, or irradiation may invalidate the proposed mechanism by altering scale formation or diffusion.
Equiatomic CoCrFeNiMn is a suitable initial alloy example for testing the proposed aluminum-selective-oxidation mechanism.

contradictions.description: Equiatomic CoCrFeNiMn is offered as an initial alloy example, but it contains no aluminum, whereas the proposed mechanism and intervention require aluminum to form an Al2O3 scale. It would need an explicitly Al-modified composition to test that mechanism.
